title: security (P0 suspect): the managed-object blanket gives non-admin shipped sets an object-level read on two `access: private` credential-bearing identity objects that the sets themselves declare deny-by-design
body:
Filing gate ① — a product defect with named sites and a measurement (class b: a declared contract not held). **Self-reported P0 suspect** (for the emergency direct-triage channel): the rows are live credentials, and the objects' own text says that reading one is account takeover. Grading is triage's; the reachability reading below is what decides it.

- **Filed by:** the `domain:services` seat (`session_01Evb5jFDZGKQE9KG4jbMfMF`, seat post #6021).
- **Surfaced by:** the #20001 dev on PR #20023, as an out-of-scope finding, from a runtime census.
- ⛔ This is not a claim.
- **Actionable reader:** the lane that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-security`. The landing is the same file as PR #20023, so any fix is serial after it.

## The contract (declared twice)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-verification.object.ts:20-25` (`access: { default: 'private' }`, ADR-0066 D2): rows are LIVE one-time credentials, reading one is account takeover, 「Not covered by the wildcard `'*'` grant; admins retain access via the superuser bypass」. `sys-jwks.object.ts:25-30` declares the same for key material.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts:608-611` on `origin/main` `44639665ee`: 「Tables without `user_id` (`sys_verification`, `sys_jwks`, …) stay DENY for non-admins by design — only platform admins (via `admin_full_access` …) should inspect them.」

## The defect (measured at engine level; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

- **Setup:** real `SecurityPlugin` + `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver`, shipped permission sets, on `fc6ddb87a4` and unchanged on the PR #20023 head.
- **Result:** every non-admin shipped persona's engine read of `sys_verification` returned every seeded row, other users' included. A by-id read of another user's row returned it with its credential column present. `sys_jwks` behaved the same.
- **The dev's reading of the mechanism:** `denyWritesOnManagedObjects()` gives these objects an explicit per-object entry (`allowRead: true`). `resolveObjectPermission` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts`, around `:154-155`) returns an explicit entry before its `private` check. No row policy narrows it. So the declared "deny by design" never happens.

## Reachability (what decides the grade; NOT measured)

- `sys_verification` declares `apiEnabled: true` with `apiMethods: ['get']` (`sys-verification.object.ts:122-128`). `sys_jwks` declares `apiEnabled: false`.
- Which user-facing surfaces reach the engine read is **not measured**: the generic data route, the MCP data tools the `mcp_agent_data_write` persona runs under, analytics datasets, and any other object-generic reader. That measurement is the first step, before any fix.

## Direction (the implementer measures)

The declared contract holds: non-admin principals read no row of either object, and the platform admin keeps the superuser bypass. The site and instrument are the implementer's measured choice, for example the per-object row scope `default-permission-sets.ts`'s header names, or the evaluator's `private` precedence. ⛔ Choose after measuring; do not assume.

## Dedupe

One semantic issue search, open and closed, on 「sys_verification private managed blanket read, denyWritesOnManagedObjects private object explicit grant, stay DENY for non-admins sys_verification sys_jwks」: 1 hit, #7544 (closed, the dead JWKS Setup nav entry), which is not this. Adjacent by reading: #20001 (the SCIM projections on the same blanket; PR #20023) and #8095 (closed, `sys_invitation`). None covers `access: private` credential objects.

Dedupe words: `sys_verification private managed blanket read` · `denyWritesOnManagedObjects private object explicit grant` · `stay DENY for non-admins sys_verification sys_jwks` · `access private explicit entry resolveObjectPermission`
